svg.text: How one call flows through the system. Numbers 1 to 7 follow the steps in the box at the bottom left.
The model talks and extracts details. Code decides what happens next.
Telnyx Edge function: dispatch (TypeScript, public URL)
durable copy, off the call path
JSON logs (no phone numbers), latency timers, /health, /admin/job-state
The webhook /dv returns who is calling.
The workflow asks questions, then calls tools.
One technician is held and the job is recorded.
Code starts the ring to the technician.
Technician presses 1 to accept or 2 to decline.
Details SMS to the technician, or an alert to the manager.
